title: melgarafael/DeskcommCRM: self-hosted AI sales workflows for chat
friendlyTitle: A self-hosted CRM with WhatsApp and AI agents
summary: DeskcommCRM is an actively developed, MIT-licensed CRM that combines WhatsApp messaging, multi-tenant customer management, native AI agents, RAG and MCP support. It targets businesses that sell and support customers through chat.
friendlySummary: DeskcommCRM brings customer records, chat sales and AI helpers into one open-source system.
whyItMatters: Small teams can study or self-host a full sales-automation stack rather than assemble CRM, messaging and agent components separately. Before production use, review WhatsApp provider rules, regional privacy obligations, deployment hardening and the project’s Portuguese-language documentation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test AI-assisted sales and support on your own server, after checking privacy, security and WhatsApp rules.
